DTTPayloadRef.description:
Where a block of bytes lives and how it is verified. The payload lane is
CID-first: a tile record addresses its bytes so an epoch can be verified
rather than trusted, and carries them inline only when the block is small
enough that a second fetch costs more than it saves. Exactly one of CID or
BYTES is the authority for a given ref; when both are present the bytes
MUST hash to the CID.

CID.description: Content identifier of the block in the dataset lane.

BYTES.description:
The block inline. Reserved for small blocks; a tile pyramid is
distributed by CID, never by embedding megabytes per record.

SIZE_BYTES.description:
Length of the block in bytes, whether inline or referenced, so a
consumer can budget a fetch before making it.

DIGEST.description:
Multihash of the block, lowercase hexadecimal, when the publisher states
one independently of the CID.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
Content encoding applied to the block before hashing, verbatim, when the
bytes are stored compressed or re-encoded. The token is an HTTP
content-coding (for example gzip) or a publisher-named lossless
re-encoding of the PAYLOAD_FORMAT bytes (for example
qm-edge-matched-planes-v1, a quantized mesh whose topology is rebuilt
from a descriptor). Decoding the stored bytes yields the PAYLOAD_FORMAT
bytes exactly; a consumer that does not know the token refuses the block.
SIZE_BYTES and DIGEST describe the stored bytes. A file of size-prefixed
records may itself be stored compressed as a whole (for example gzip,
named with a .gz suffix); that wrapping belongs to the file, not to the
block, and is not stated here.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the block as the publisher serves it.

DTTProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one terrain tile.

Required on every record: a redistributed elevation tile whose dataset,
epoch, and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is
DATA: DATASET_ID, DATASET_NAME, and ATTRIBUTION carry verbatim what the
source states about itself. The standard names no dataset, mission, agency,
or vendor.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the elevation dataset this
tile was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this tile was
derived from. The edition boundary, not the fetch: two tiles carrying the
same DATASET_ID and DATASET_EPOCH were cut from the same bytes.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact tile, granule, or file selection used, so the same source
bytes can be recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display,
carried verbatim so a surface can render it without composing its own
credit line.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the granule this tile was cut from,
verbatim. The join key back to the source dataset.

GENERATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which this tile's bytes were produced by the
publisher, as distinct from the dataset edition they were cut from.

PROCESSOR.description:
Identifier of the processing pipeline and its version that produced the
tile bytes, so two tiles from one edition but different pipelines are
distinguishable.

DTT.description:
Digital Terrain Tile

One addressable tile of a terrain elevation pyramid: its address in a
stated tiling scheme, its geographic extent, its payload encoding and where
those bytes live, the vertical datum its heights are measured from, what it
states about water cover, and the dataset edition and licence it was
redistributed under.

$DTT is the SERVED ARTIFACT of a terrain lane and is deliberately not
$TRN, which configures how a consumer uses terrain (sources, interpolation,
cache size, exaggeration) and holds no elevation; nor $TRS, which is a
radio-propagation solve over terrain heights. A terrain service publishes
$DTT records, is configured by $TRN, and its heights may be consumed by
$TRS.

Angles are decimal degrees on WGS 84 and heights are metres. A tile of
another body names it in CENTER_NAME; its angles are then planetocentric
degrees on that body's reference body (REFERENCE_RADII_M), not WGS 84. Tile bytes are
referenced by content identifier by default; see DTTPayloadRef.

TILESET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for the tile pyramid (the tileset) this tile
belongs to. Tiles of one pyramid share a scheme, format, and datum.

TILESET_NAME.description: The tileset's own name, verbatim, for display.

TILING_SCHEME.description: Scheme the address below is expressed in.

LEVEL.description: Zoom level of the tile, 0 at the pyramid root.

X.description: Column index within LEVEL, increasing eastward from the scheme origin.

Y.description:
Row index within LEVEL, increasing in the scheme's own row direction;
ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH states which.

ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH.description:
Row index 0 lies at the north edge of the scheme. When false, row 0 lies
at the south edge.

WEST_DEG.description:
Western extent of the tile, decimal degrees on CENTER_NAME's reference
body (WGS 84 for EARTH; planetocentric for any other body).

SOUTH_DEG.description:
Southern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on CENTER_NAME's reference
body (planetocentric for any body other than EARTH).

EAST_DEG.description:
Eastern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on CENTER_NAME's reference
body (planetocentric for any body other than EARTH), east positive.

NORTH_DEG.description:
Northern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on CENTER_NAME's reference
body (planetocentric for any body other than EARTH).

MIN_HEIGHT_M.description:
Lowest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM. Stated
so a consumer can build a bounding volume without decoding the payload.

MAX_HEIGHT_M.description: Highest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM.

PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION.description:
Version of PAYLOAD_FORMAT the bytes conform to, verbatim, when the
format is versioned.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Number of height posts across the tile for gridded formats. Unset for
mesh formats, whose vertex count varies.

GRID_HEIGHT.description: Number of height posts down the tile for gridded formats.

POST_SPACING_M.description:
Nominal ground distance between adjacent height posts at the tile
centre, metres. The tile's effective resolution as served, which is not
necessarily the source dataset's native post spacing.

SOURCE_POST_SPACING_M.description:
Native post spacing of the source elevations, metres, when the tile was
resampled from a coarser or finer grid.

VERTICAL_DATUM.description: Surface the heights are measured from.

VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
The datum, geoid model, or vertical reference frame named verbatim as
its authority states it.

HORIZONTAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
Horizontal reference frame the extent is expressed in, verbatim, when it
is not WGS 84.

VERTICAL_ACCURACY_M.description:
Vertical accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres, at the
confidence level stated in ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.

ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.description:
Confidence level the accuracy figures are stated at, as a fraction
between 0 and 1.

HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY_M.description: Horizontal accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres.

DATA_COVERAGE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the tile extent covered by real measurements rather than
interpolated or filled values, between 0 and 1.

NO_DATA_VALUE.description: Height value used to mark absent samples in gridded payloads.

WATER_MASK_KIND.description: What the tile states about water cover.

WATER_MASK.description:
The per-sample water mask bytes when WATER_MASK_KIND is RASTER: one
unsigned byte per sample, 255 fully water, 0 fully land.

WATER_MASK_WIDTH.description:
Number of mask samples across and down the tile when WATER_MASK_KIND is
RASTER. Independent of GRID_WIDTH/GRID_HEIGHT: a mask is commonly
carried at a different resolution than the heights.

WATER_MASK_PROVENANCE.description:
Dataset the water mask was derived from, when it is not the elevation
dataset. A separate lineage because a mask carries its own licence.

VERTEX_NORMALS.description:
Per-sample surface normals accompanying the tile, when the publisher
serves them, so a consumer need not derive lighting from heights.

LAND_COVER.description:
Per-sample land-cover classification accompanying the tile, when the
publisher serves one.

CHILD_AVAILABILITY.description:
Availability of the four child tiles at LEVEL+1, as the low four bits:
bit 0 south-west, bit 1 south-east, bit 2 north-west, bit 3 north-east.
A set bit states the child exists in this tileset.

MAX_LEVEL.description:
The deepest level this tileset serves anywhere. A consumer stops
requesting below it rather than discovering absence by failed fetches.

SOURCE_CLASS.description: Production technique class of the source elevations.

PROVENANCE.description: Dataset lineage and redistribution terms. Required.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch the elevations represent, when the
dataset states an observation epoch distinct from its edition. Terrain
changes; a tile compared across time is compared at this epoch.

ETAG.description: Entity tag for the served bytes, verbatim, so a cache can revalidate.

EXPIRES.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp after which this tile should be revalidated.

REMARKS.description:
Free-form publisher notes about this tile. Never a substitute for a
stated field.

CENTER_NAME.description:
The body the tile describes, spelled as the CCSDS ODM/OMM CENTER_NAME
keyword (SANA celestial body registry: EARTH, MOON, MARS). Absent means
EARTH, so every tile published before 1.191.0 reads unchanged.

REFERENCE_RADII_M.description:
Radii of CENTER_NAME's reference body, metres. One value is a sphere;
two are equatorial then polar (a spheroid); three are the semi-axes a
(towards 0 degrees longitude), b (towards 90 degrees east) and c (polar).
Empty for EARTH, whose shape is WGS 84. Required for a REFERENCE_SPHERE
datum, which reads the first value.

HORIZON_ELEVATIONS.description:
Horizon elevation angles the publisher precomputed for the tile's posts,
for lighting and visibility without a height search. One unsigned byte
per post and sector: posts in the order of PAYLOAD's grid (row-major from
the north-west post), sector the fastest index. Sector k is centred on
azimuth k*360/HORIZON_SECTORS degrees, clockwise from north. A byte v is
the elevation angle of the terrain horizon above the local horizontal at
the post, v*90/255 degrees; a horizon at or below the horizontal is 0.

HORIZON_SECTORS.description: Number of azimuth sectors in HORIZON_ELEVATIONS (0 when it is absent).

SRTClass.description: One class of a categorical raster.

TILESET_ID.description: Stable identity of the tileset this tile belongs to.

UNIT.description: UCUM unit of the scaled value (m for canopy height); absent for classes.

NO_DATA_VALUE.description: Stored sample value meaning no data (WorldCover: 0).

CLASS_LEGEND.description: Class legend; required when QUANTITY = CATEGORICAL_CLASS.

CRS.description: Coordinate reference system, verbatim (e.g. EPSG:4326, EPSG:3857).

AFFINE_TRANSFORM.description: GDAL geotransform, 6 values, mapping pixel corners to CRS units.

TILING_SCHEME.description: Optional pyramid address scheme (canopy quadkey tiles = WEB_MERCATOR).

WEST_DEG.description: Geographic bounding box, west edge in degrees.

SOUTH_DEG.description: Geographic bounding box, south edge in degrees.

EAST_DEG.description: Geographic bounding box, east edge in degrees.

NORTH_DEG.description: Geographic bounding box, north edge in degrees.

PAYLOAD.description: Native samples only: no palette conversion, resampling or rounding.

MIN_VALUE.description: Minimum scaled value in the tile.

MAX_VALUE.description: Maximum scaled value in the tile.

DATA_COVERAGE_FRACTION.description: Fraction of samples that are not NO_DATA_VALUE, 0 to 1.

EPOCH.description: Dataset epoch of the samples, RFC 3339 UTC.
